story.who: Nvidia, the American A I chip giant, and electronics maker LG of South Korea; carmaker Hyundai is expected to use their work
story.what: have reportedly begun building the A I that runs a car, joining Nvidia's self-driving system with LG's in-car software, for Hyundai's first mass-produced self-driving car; the report rests on unnamed industry sources, Hyundai's use is expected and it is only said to be reviewing LG's part; Hyundai itself plans cars with advanced driving help, short of driverless, using Nvidia from twenty twenty eight
story.why_for_people: everyday drivers could get Hyundai's first mass-produced self-driving car, with more A I help at the wheel, if the report holds
story.script: On the road. N-vidia and electronics maker LG are reportedly building the A I for Hyundai's first self-driving car for everyday drivers.
story.screen: a small glowing car with simple curved sensor waves spreading out in front of it, text-free symbol

fun.who: Amazon; Alexa Plus, the A I-based version of Amazon's Alexa voice helper
fun.what: says a bug made some Alexa Plus helpers get stuck repeating the word la over and over, which users had reported for about a month, and that a fix is being put in; Amazon says only a small number of users were hit and gives no cause
fun.why_for_people: people whose Alexa Plus got stuck saying la la la are getting a fix; Amazon says only a small number were hit
fun.script: Just for fun. Amazon says a bug left some Alexa Plus A I helpers stuck saying la la la over and over, and a fix is coming.
